newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on funds, hedges, speculators.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on funds, hedges, speculators.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on fund, hedge and speculative selling following CBOT soy values.

"There were huge hedges, we hit stops in the March at $407, there was spec selling and large exports," a trader said. Crushers bought 200 March at $407.50/tonne, 200 May and 300 July while Cargill sold 300 November. March futures crush profit margin rose to a crop year high of -21.02 from -22.87 Thursday on CBOT soy oil, meal. Mar-May $0.50, Mar-Nov $37.
Japan bought 30,000 tonnes overnight, two sources said.
March canola lost $3.80 to $404.60, May down $4.90 to $403.10. May flax fell $2.20 to $345.70 on 50 hedges.

February western barley fell $0.20 to $136, March lost $0.50 to $134.80 on local and hedge selling to commercials. Commission houses bought the Feb-Mar at $0.30, Feb-May $1 and Mar-May spread at even money from commercials.
March feed wheat lost $2.90 to $166 on local, commercial liquidation. Locals, commercials sold Mar-May $3, Mar-July $6.
Cargill and UGG bought May feed peas down US$1.20 at US$197.30, October down US$4.50 to US$182.50 and RBC-DS sold December down US$3.50 to US$184.50. Oats did not trade.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
